en.platformPack.guidedAudit.manifest.title: Guided coffee process audit

en.platformPack.guidedAudit.competency.desc: Evaluate process, ledger, document, and policy evidence to form proportionate audit findings.

en.platformPack.guidedAudit.indicator.class: Classifies severity, materiality, root cause, and recommendation proportionately.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.indicator.concl: Forms a scoped conclusion that distinguishes findings, legitimate exceptions, and evidence limitations.

The workpaper identifies relevant control exceptions and supports them with evidence and policy.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.scenario.title: Completed coffee process audit
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.node.briefing.b: Inspect the immutable source records, cite evidence and policy, record findings, and issue a scoped audit conclusion.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.objective: Determine whether certificate acceptance, quantity correction, and recall authorization controls operated as intended while preserving legitimate append-only ledger history.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.scope: Certificate, quantity-correction, and recall controls for BAT_GREEN_COFFEE_001
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.category.author: Authorization control
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.root.expiryRevi: Validity review was not completed before acceptance
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.root.roleContro: The initial action occurred before authorized role handoff
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.recommend.hold: Hold the lot until certificate validity is resolved
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.recommend.docum: Require a documented discrepancy investigation before correction
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.recommend.hando: Require regulator handoff before recall commitment
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.recommend.none: Do not raise a finding; retain the evidence as reviewed
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.conclusion.insu: Evidence is insufficient for a conclusion
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.record.custody: Custody transfer endorsed by sender and receiver
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.record.receipt: Receipt recorded a 900 kg discrepancy without investigation notes
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.record.correcti: Quantity corrected through an endorsed append-only transaction
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.record.recallAt: Recall attempt rejected under an unauthorized role
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.record.delay: Three-hour transit delay recorded without loss evidence
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.finding.certifi: The certificate had expired before the review date, yet the lot continued. The registry confirms the issuer was recognized, but recognition does not restore an expired document.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.finding.documen: The append-only correction preserved ledger history, but the receiving report does not document how the 900 kg discrepancy was investigated.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.finding.authori: Recall was first attempted under an unauthorized role
The rejected attempt did not enter the ledger, but it is evidence that the recall control was invoked before the regulator handoff.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.decoy.correctio: The original quantity remained in history and both producer and processor endorsed the correction. This unusual change is a legitimate append-only transaction, not a ledger-integrity failure.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.decoy.delay: A delay is unusual, but the available evidence does not show loss, contamination, or policy breach. Record it as an evidence limitation rather than an unsupported finding.
en.platformPack.guidedAudit.feedback.unsupp: The selected category and entity pair is not supported as a finding by the evidence available in this audit scope.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.manifest.desc: A concise evidence-led audit of certificate authorization, custody endorsement, and correction-proposal controls.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.manifest.purp: Practise independent control testing with on-request hints and append-only workpaper amendments.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.node.briefing: Plan and perform the practice audit
Review the scope, inspect the records without anomaly markers, support each finding with evidence and policy, and issue a conclusion.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.objective: Assess whether certificate authorization, custody endorsement, and quantity-correction proposal controls operated as intended.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.scope: Certificate, custody-transfer, and quantity-correction controls for BAT_GREEN_COFFEE_204
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.evidence.rece: Receiving report for the transferred lot
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.record.receip: Processor receipt recorded after physical handoff
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.record.correc: Processor proposed an append-only quantity correction
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.record.recall: Regulator committed an authorized emergency recall
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.root.authoriz: Signer authorization was not checked before submission
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.root.receiver: Receiver acceptance was not obtained before recording transfer
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.recommend.aut: Require an authorized certifier before certificate submission
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.recommend.rec: Require receiver endorsement before custody transfer
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.recommend.pro: Create one revised proposal and collect matching endorsements
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.hint.authoriz: Compare what the signer is allowed to do with the action shown in the certificate record.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.hint.custody: Check whether both parties approved the same custody transfer before commitment was attempted.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.hint.proposal: Compare the proposal digests and corrected quantities in both endorsement records.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.finding.certi: Certificate action used an unauthorized signer
The transporter signature is cryptographically valid and the organization is recognized, but the registry does not authorize the transporter to issue quality certificates.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.finding.custo: Custody transfer was attempted without receiver endorsement
The sender endorsed release, but no receiving-custodian endorsement existed. The attempt remained in audit history and did not enter the ledger.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.finding.corre: Correction endorsements referred to different proposals
Both signatures verify individually, but the processor and producer signed different proposal digests, so the endorsement policy was not satisfied.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.decoy.recall: The regulator used the authorized role and the emergency-recall record is supported by policy. It is a legitimate control action.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.decoy.varianc: The 25 kg variance is within the authored tolerance and has a documented handling explanation. The available evidence does not support a finding.
en.platformPack.practiceAudit.feedback.unsu: The selected category and entity pair is not supported as a finding by the evidence in this practice scope.

vi.platformPack.guidedAudit.decoy.delay: Chậm trễ là bất thường, nhưng bằng chứng hiện có không cho thấy tổn thất, nhiễm bẩn hay vi phạm chính sách. Hãy ghi đây là giới hạn bằng chứng thay vì nêu một phát hiện không được hỗ trợ.
